pages.note: Rebuilt 2026-09-15 as the ten most-starred public repositories that depend on Extension.js, rendered from the generated block in snippets/used-by.jsx. Each entry was verified by reading its package.json (dependency on `extension` at 1.1.1 or later or a dist-tag, plus a script calling the CLI) and the presence of a manifest.json: ApolloAuto/apollo dreamview-debug-extension (latest), better-lyrics/better-lyrics (^4.1.5), apades/dmMiniPlayer packages/element-picker-ext (^4.0.32), BharathxD/ClaimeAI apps/extension (^2.0.0-rc.23), debpalash/Opal extension (^3.0.0), SpreadSheets600/TidyTabs (^3.0.0), sarvan-2187/Bookmrk (^4.1.17), joaomagfreitas/send-to-pocket-book extension (latest), migteam/better-trello-browser-extension (latest), itsmemeworks/adhx extension (^4.1.5). Four are secondary packages (Apollo debug tool, dmMiniPlayer picker test harness, ClaimeAI helper, plus Opal and ADHX which are the only extension of a desktop or web app); their cards say so and never link another product's store listing. Store ids were checked against listing titles, because the Chrome Web Store answers 200 for unknown ids; TidyTabs uses the AMO slug tidytabs-openrouter, whose support URL is its repository. Users, rating, version and stars come from scripts/used-by/refresh.mjs (Firefox Add-ons API v5, Edge getproductdetailsbycrxid, Chrome Web Store page, GitHub REST), floored to two significant digits, and stars are shown only for projects at a repository root. Icons and screenshots come from each repository or its official Firefox Add-ons listing.
